# name: The revolt of the household things; the monkeys; the pride of Vucub Caquix
# title: Cax xiban chique, xoh itio
# fols: fols. 5r–6r
“Cax xiban chique; xoh itio; ix chi cut xquix cati chic,” xꜭha ri qui ꜩi, cac chiquech.

Are cu ri ꜫaa: “Xoh coconic ivumal; hutaꜫih, hutaꜫih, xꜫec, zaquiric, amaꜫel, holi, holi, huqui, huqui ca vach ivumal; are ta nabe ca patan chivach, ix ta na vinac. Vacamic cut xchitih ca chucab; xchicaqueech, xchicahoc puch itiohil,” xꜭha ri qui ꜫaa chique.

Are cu ri qui ꜩi xꜭha chic, ta xꜭhauic: “Naquipa rumal mavi chiya ca va? Xa coh mucunic, xa pu coh icuxih vloc, coh izac pu vloc; yacal vbi ca cheel ivumal, ta quix vaic. Xere coh ivuchaah vi; mavi coh ꜭhauic. Ma ta cu mi xoh camic chive? Hupacha mavi mi xix nauic, xix nau ta cut chivih ta cut? Xoh zach vi; vacamic cut xchitih ca bac ꜭo pa ca chi; xquix catio,” xeꜭha ri ꜩi chique, ta xcut qui vach.

Are chi cu ri qui xot, qui boh xꜭhau chic chique: “Cax, ra xiban chique; xac ca chi, xac ca vach; amaꜫel oh ꜩacal chuvi cac, coh icato; mavi cax xca nao. Xchitih cut, xquix caporoh,” xcha ri qui boh; ronohel xcute qui vach.

Are ri abah ri qui xcub chi ta ninic chi pe pa ꜫaꜫ taꜫal chi qui holom; cax xban chique.

Anilabic que mal, malihab chic; que rah acanic chuvi ha, xa chi vvlih ha que ꜩac vloc; que rah acan chuvi che, que ꜭhaquix vloc ruma che; que rah oc pa hul, xa chi yuch hul chi qui vach.

Quehe cut vcayohic vinac ꜯac, vinac bit, e ꜩixel, e ꜩalaꜩoxel chi vinac; xmayxic, xcutuxic qui chi, qui vach conohel.

Xꜭha cut, are vetal ri ꜭoy ꜭo pa quechelah vacamic; are xꜭohe vi vetal, rumal xa che qui tiohil xcohic rumal Ahꜯac, Ahbit.

Are cu ri ꜭoy queheri vinac chi vachinic, vetal hule vinac ꜯac, vinac bit, xa poy, xa pu aham che.

Are cut xa hubic zacnatanoh vvach vleu; mahabi ꜫih. Hun cut cu nimarizah rib, Vvcub Caquix vbi. Ꜭo nabe cah, vleu; xa ca moymot vvach ꜫih, ic.

Ca ꜭha cu ri: “Xavi xere vzaquetal vinac ri xbutic; queheri naual vinac vꜭoheic. In nim quiꜭohe chic chuvi vinac ꜯac, vinac bit. In vꜫih, in pu vzac, in nai pu riquil; ta chuxoc. Nim nu zaquil; in binibal, in pu chacabal rumal vinac, rumal puvac vbac nu vach; xa ca tiltotic chi yamanic raxa cuval; nay pu ve raxcavacoh chi abah, queheri vva cah. Are cu ri nu ꜩam zachuluhuh chi nah queheri ic; puvac cut nu calibal; ca zacpaque vvach vleu ta quinel vloc chuvach nu calibal. Quehe cut in ꜫih vi, in pu ic, rumal zaquil al, zaquil ꜭahol. Ta chuxoc, rumal chi nah copon vi nu vach.”

Ꜭha ri Vvcub Caquix. Ma ca quiꜩih are ta ꜫih ri Vucub Caquix; xere cu nimarizah rib ri vxic, vpuvac. Xere cut tocol vi vvach ri chi cube vi; mana ronohel ta vxecah copon vi vvach.

Maha cut qui quiloc vvach ꜫih, ic, chumil; maha oc ca zaquir oc. Quehe cut cu cobizah vi rib ri Vucub Caquix chi ꜫihil, chi iquil; xa maha chi cutun oc, chi calahob oc vzaquil ꜫih, ic; xa xuraih nimal icouen.

Are ta xbanic butic cumal poy, aham che. Quehe cut xchicabyih chic ta xcamic Vucub Caquix, ta xchacatahic, ta xbanatahic vinac rumal Ahꜯac, Ahbit.
